market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham United are a stable mid-table Premier League club with strong financial backing and a squad that has consistently avoided relegation battles. Their recent finishes (9th, 14th, 7th, 6th) and overall quality suggest relegation is unlikely, even projecting two seasons ahead. The market-implied 34.5% chance seems excessively high, likely reflecting misplaced risk pricing rather than fundamentals.
evidence_points: Finished 9th in 2023–24, 14th in 2022–23, 7th in 2021–22, and 6th in 2020–21 — no relegation threat.
Only three clubs are relegated each season; in a 20‑team league, mid‑table clubs typically have less than 25% relegation risk per season.
West Ham’s wage bill and transfer spending place them in the top half of the league, reducing the likelihood of a catastrophic drop.
sources_consulted: Bookmaker relegation odds for West Ham in previous seasons (Oddschecker historical data)
Squad market value and financial reports (Transfermarkt, Deloitte)
